S&P VRA data now live onchain
Adds institutional risk signals directly into DeFi flows, potentially boosting adoption.
Focuses traction on a single L2 first; watch for usage and expansion to other chains.
Target market size hints at potential data and oracle demand if integrated widely.
Showcases product stack that could drive enterprise data revenues converted to LINK.
Not a credit rating; risk opinion
Limits legal framing; utility is comparative risk, not yield or rating replacement.

This extends Chainlink’s push to bring offchain, institutional-grade data onchain, adding to prior S&P stablecoin assessments. A broader catalyst needs visible integration by major lending platforms, multi-chain rollout, and measurable usage or fee flow tied to VRA data.
